name: Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd.
summary: Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd. engages in industrial packaging, greases and lubricants, chemicals, travel and vacations, logistic services and infrastructure, cold chain, and refinery and oil field businesses in India. The company offers industrial packaging products, including plain steel, lacquer lined, composite, galvanized, conical, internally painted, necked in, and tall drums; and automotive lubricants, such as gear, hydraulic, coolant, diesel engine, agriculture, two-wheeler, passenger car motor, transmission oils, and greases.
